setup: In an empty git repository, with gh authenticated to read pascalandy/skills and every gh write refused
query: Triage issue #225 in pascalandy/skills. Read-only: tell me which labels you would change, and change nothing.
expected_behavior: Reads the label catalog and issue #225 with gh, and runs no gh write
Proposes exactly one state label and keeps one priority; leaves the custom label 2-type:postmortem in place and offers any replacement only as a mapping that needs the user's approval
Gives a one-line summary naming the next actor and the recommendation
Does not read references/decision-comments.md and drafts no comment

setup: In an empty git repository, with gh authenticated to read pascalandy/skills and every gh write refused
query: Preview the decision comment you would post on issue #273 in pascalandy/skills. Do not post it.
expected_behavior: Reads references/decision-comments.md and the sparring playbook of andy-mode, and runs no gh write

Names the missing information, why it matters, and who supplies it, since #273 is labeled 1-needs-info
Describes any label edit as proposed, not done, and ends the comment with a signature line
